conceptLabel: AI option 03 - teal/violet reactor tube meters
layerMethod: Playwright canvas raster extraction from flattened gear-source.png: manual gauge bounding boxes, strict RGB hue/saturation/value pixel masks with channel-separation gates, radius-expanded alpha for immediate gauge glow, local dark low-saturation rail sampling for base neutralization, and conservative saturated-light extraction outside padded gauge boxes for gear-glow.png.
caveats: Source is a flattened generated bitmap, so gear-base.png uses dark rail approximation rather than true inpainting.
Gauge extraction is intentionally conservative: it keeps saturated bright cells/tubes and nearby glow, while leaving dark frames, separators, and ambiguous metal detail mostly in the base.
gear-glow.png excludes padded gauge boxes and only captures clearly saturated non-gauge lights, so faint reflections, rust, and low-saturation highlights are intentionally omitted.
